description: Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity Intrusion Detection System 2017 dataset — labeled network flow data for intrusion detection research.

official_source.name: Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity, University of New Brunswick
official_source.citation: Sharafaldin, I., Lashkari, A. H., & Ghorbani, A. A. (2018). Toward Generating a New Intrusion Detection Dataset and Intrusion Traffic Characterization. ICISSP, Portugal, January 2018.

archives.name: GeneratedLabelledFlows.zip
archives.description: Labeled flow CSV files generated by CICFlowMeter (one per day/session)
archives.notes: Primary archive for ML training. Contains Monday–Friday labeled flow CSVs.

archives.name: PCAPs.zip
archives.description: Raw packet capture files corresponding to each labeled-flow CSV
archives.notes: Out of v1.0 scope; useful for re-extracting flows or packet-level analysis.

archives.name: MachineLearningCSV.zip
archives.description: Alternative packaging of labeled flow CSVs
archives.notes: Alternative to GeneratedLabelledFlows.zip; contains the same CSV flow data.

csv_files.name: Tuesday-WorkingHours.pcap_ISCX.csv
csv_files.description: Brute Force FTP + Brute Force SSH + normal

csv_files.name: Thursday-WorkingHours-Morning-WebAttacks.pcap_ISCX.csv
csv_files.description: Web Attacks (Brute Force, XSS, SQL Injection) + normal

verification.notes: SHA-256 checksums are placeholders (null) until the archives are downloaded and verified locally. Do not invent checksums.

limitations: Official download requires registration form; no direct programmatic URL
Raw CSVs contain NaN/Infinity values requiring cleaning
Some CSV exports contain duplicate columns
Identifier columns (Flow ID, IPs, ports, Timestamp) can cause shortcut learning
Class imbalance: benign traffic vastly outnumbers most attack categories
Single enterprise-like topology over 5 days; limited generalization
Original labels may contain inconsistencies (see Engelen et al. 2021)
repository_policy: Dataset files are never committed to Git. Only this manifest and documentation are tracked. See .gitignore.
